briefings.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar detailed the company's path to profitability and an eventual IPO, highlighting $122 billion in Q1 fundraising, a $1.25 trillion valuation in its latest opportunistic round, 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users, and a $1 billion advertising run rate achieved in under 200 days.

briefings.title: Former US Treasury Secretary Warns Of ‘Underestimating’ Risk Of AI Financial Crisis
briefings.tldr: Former US Treasury Secretary Hank Paulson and former UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak warned that while the US leads in AI innovation, China is winning the long game on distribution and domestic adoption—and the West is severely underestimating both the financial bubble risks and the potential for a catastrophic AI accident to trigger a market and regulatory collapse.
